body:
@dsnopek I'm wondering if we want to allow such platform specific callback for gdextensions?

@Rinnegatamante Do note that [`DisplayServer#window_get_native_handle(...)`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_displayserver.html#class-displayserver-method-window-get-native-handle) provides a [mean to access the activity](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/9273a6a9a04d12299f05aa34606a1c386a00deda/platform/android/display_server_android.cpp#L492) though I'm unsure whether it's available early enough for what you're trying to accomplish.
